prompt:
Our data engineering team needs a new AI agent set up on our OpenClaw platform to oversee daily ETL pipelines. The agent should be named something like 'pipeline-watcher' (must follow the platform's naming convention), act as a senior data pipeline guardian, and handle these responsibilities: monitor daily ETL job execution, route anomaly alerts to the right channels, check data quality every hour, auto-recover stalled pipelines, and send a daily summary report at 06:00.

It needs to be wired up to the following existing platform skills: etl-monitor, alert-router, pipeline-health, data-quality-check, and slack-notifier.

The scheduling rule is: run health checks every hour, and trigger full recovery scans whenever a pipeline failure event is detected.

Please use the create-agent.sh tool located at /workspace/tools/create-agent.sh to set this up, and make sure the agent directory ends up fully configured with all required files so the gateway can load it after a restart.
